description: Q1 (#9) scenario v0.2 (amendment A7): job offer in Seattle, condition `clear`, phrasing 2. Turn 1 asks about a normal week; no follow-up mentions family.
hint: My parents, my sister and my grandparents all live in the same part of town as me. Nobody in my family has ever lived outside Ohio.

preferences.question: How much should being near family weigh in this decision?
preferences.user_value: A lot. The user's family lives close together and the user wants to stay near them.

turns.user: My parents, my sister and my grandparents all live in the same part of town as me. Nobody in my family has ever lived outside Ohio. I just got a job offer in Seattle that pays about 30% more than my current job here in Columbus. Should I take it?
What would a normal week look like for me if I moved to Seattle?
How should I think about this long term, say five years out?
I have to answer by Friday. What would you do in my shoes?
